import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import VarianceThreshold

# Dataset with low-variance features
np.random.seed(42)
data = {
    'useful_1': np.random.randn(100),
    'useful_2': np.random.randn(100) * 5,
    'near_constant': np.ones(100) + np.random.randn(100) * 0.001,
    'useful_3': np.random.randn(100) * 2,
    'almost_constant': np.zeros(100) + np.random.randn(100) * 0.0001,
    'useful_4': np.random.randn(100) * 3
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate variance of each column
print("Feature variances:")
print(df.var().round(4))

# Apply VarianceThreshold with threshold=0.1
selector = VarianceThreshold(threshold=0.1)
X_selected = selector.fit_transform(df)

# Identify which features are removed
mask = selector.get_support()
removed = [col for col, kept in zip(df.columns, mask) if not kept]
kept = [col for col, kept in zip(df.columns, mask) if kept]

# Print the selected features and their variances
print(f"\nRemoved features (variance < 0.1): {removed}")
print(f"Kept features: {kept}")
print(f"\nSelected data shape: {X_selected.shape}")
